messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — prefilling GPU OOMs observed on cluster inference-pool-3. 12 container restarts in the last 7 minutes. Pager sent to @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Ack. Jumping in — grabbing logs and current allocations.

mike: I see repeated CUDA OOM and CUBLAS_ERROR_ALLOC in the prefill path for requests with large context (>8k). Example: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.00 GiB` followed by container restart.

priya: Confirmed. KV-cache grows as prefill proceeds, eviction not keeping up. Hotpool-3 is at 95% GPU mem and nodes are flapping.

sara: Cust Ops — we have two customers (acme-fin, beta-chat) reporting elevated errors and degraded streaming. Acme opened a support ticket ~5m ago.

cust-ops: Noting customer impact: acme-fin saw ~30% of generation requests error with 5xx in the last 10m. Sending initial heads-up.

mike: Short mitigation plan: 1) disable speculative prefetch/prefill on hotpool-3 (reduce memory pressure), 2) immediately route large-context requests (>6k tokens) to fallback pool (cpu-coldmodel or smaller model), 3) scale up hotpool-3 with new nodes if needed.

eng-runtime: Agreed. Pushing a temporary routing rule now: `route: if context_tokens >= 6000 then pool: cold-fallback` — applying to region us-west-2 only.

sre-oncall: Commands I'm running now:
```
# cordon hotpool-3 node group from receiving new prefills
redwoodctl pool set hotpool-3 --prefill-enabled=false
# add routing override
redwoodctl routes apply --rule 'context_tokens>=6000 -> cold-fallback' --region us-west-2
```

priya: I've adjusted KV cache thresholds on the runtime to evict earlier (prefill_kv_high_water=0.7). This should prevent sustained growth for in-flight long contexts. Watching telemetry.

sara: Cust Ops — messaging customers: short note to acme-fin + beta-chat: "We're investigating increased errors for long-context requests; temporary routing change applied; engineers are actively mitigating." Will post to status page if errors continue 15m.

mike: Logs show a noisy tenant sending very long streaming messages in a tight loop — likely the primary cause. Throttling that API key for 1 minute now.

eng-runtime: Hotpool-3 memory pressure dropping to ~70% after prefills disabled and routing rule applied. Container restart rate down to 0.8/min (was 3.2/min).

sre-oncall: Good. I'll keep this thread as the triage channel. If memory stabilizes for 30m, we'll follow with a post-incident summary and cleanup steps (re-enable prefill after tuning).

incident-bot: NOTE: paging cleared for this incident; severity reduced to P2. On-call remains assigned to @sre-oncall for monitoring and handoff to next rotation.

cust-ops: Customer update sent to acme-fin: "Temporary mitigation in place; reduced errors expected. We'll follow up with root cause & timeline for re-enabling large-context prefill."

priya: Follow-ups: (1) instrument per-tenant prefill token counts, (2) add graceful fallback to partial-prefill (trim prefill) when KV pressure detected, (3) run canary of new eviction heuristics on hotpool-3 tomorrow morning.

mike: I'll open a tracking ticket with logs and the noisy api-key. Assigning to eng-runtime for the longer-term fix.

sre-oncall: Handoff note for next rotation: watch hotpool-3 mem, keep prefill disabled until eng-runtime confirms canary results. I'll update oncall playbook with commands we ran.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging; incident remains in monitoring state."
